release_notes:
A fresh new look for Chairside Ready Alert.

- New design: cleaner cards, a gradient Ready button that turns green and shows who you sent to, and a header showing how many stations are online. Works with all five color themes (Layout menu).
- Ready Messages: the newest Ready is a large highlighted card at the bottom showing how long ago it arrived ("Just now", "4 min ago"). Older Readys are simple rows lined up underneath its name; your own sent Readys are small grey "Sent to ..." rows with an arrow, kept above the two newest incoming Readys so they never get in the way.
- Send to: station buttons now sit in neat, centered rows that rewrap to fit any window size or screen.
- Alert sound and volume moved to a strip under Send to.
- This station's name: shown at the top left with an Edit link (also Settings > This Station's Name). New installs are asked for a name on first launch. You can pick a name from the list or type a new one. Changing it shows a gentle reminder that you don't need to rename your station to send a Ready -- pick who to alert under Send to.
- Stick-figure celebrations are redrawn with smoother, more expressive animation and now appear about once every 4 Ready sends (still at most one per 10 minutes).
